description: Where a grid span stands: its state (planned, scheduled, posting, held, done, failed), a short label such as "posting 2 of 3", and every tile with its post, picture and target states. A failed tile stopped the set there; retry just that tile (target_retry). The app listens for changes. The grid crop figure is unmeasured, so this stays off until the owner measures it with a test post on a real profile.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
